LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostShip_EnterDesc: Send colonists into the ghost ship's interior.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostShip_EnterLocked: The ship is heading for the erosion shore. Boarding is not available yet.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostShip_StatusOrbiting: Approaching the erosion shore — boarding locked.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostShip_DevViewInteriorDesc: Generate the pocket map and jump the camera inside the ship.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostShip_DevViewInteriorFaile: Could not generate the ship interior map.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostShip_OrbitStarted: A ghost ship steers toward the first erosion shore, dumps the dead in a single wave, then withdraws offshore after 3 hours. It repeats this every 6 hours.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostShip_Unlocked: The ghost ship completes its circuit and drifts in. Boarding is unlocked.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostShip_ResurrectionWave: The docked ship releases a resurrection wave. The living refuse death once more, and the fallen rise.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostShip_AssaultStarted: The released ghosts surge inland as one.
